newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ weekly movement falls to 3.575 mln gallons.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ weekly movement falls to 3.575 mln gallons.

text.p: Florida Citrus Processors Association said frozen concentrated orange juice movement into trade channels for the week ended July 5 was 3,575,210 gallons versus 4,673,082 gallons last week.
Imports were 824,344 gallons compared with 282,729 gallons the previous week. There were no domestic receipts for this week compared to 1,114 last week.
Retail movement was 622,104 gallons, while bulk movement was 2,461,205 gallons.
The net cumulative pack for the season is 242,230,098 gallons.
